name: 21st Dev
description: Search UI components, retrieve code, and generate designs with 21st Dev.

methods.whenToUse: Connect the hosted 21st MCP server with your account's API key.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in at 21st.dev/mcp, create a fresh API key for the account agents should use, and paste it below. Keys from the retired Magic console no longer work.
methods.label: Connect with an API key

credentialFields.label: 21st Dev API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Create a fresh API key for the account agents should use at https://21st.dev/mcp. The account controls component retrieval, library/profile changes and hosted AI access. Check get_usage.aiGenerationEnabled before generation; Paperclip cannot enable paid capabilities or increase a key’s permissions.

warnings: Component retrieval depends on your account's access. Hosted generation requires AI access and credits; check get_usage.aiGenerationEnabled before generating. Refresh tools or reconnect after enabling AI access.
